name: continued
description: Enclave (formerly Continued), a local-first AI coding agent: chat and agent mode on Ollama models on your machine or an institutional endpoint such as Blablador, every action approval-gated, and reproducible workflow-harnesses exportable to CWL.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace Enclave does not load plugins from .continued/plugins/, because loading one runs its JavaScript in the extension host. Chat, the agent and the built-in plugins all work normally.

continued.ollama.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server used for local models (chat, agent and inline completion).

continued.agent.maxIterations.description: Maximum number of model/tool steps in one agent run before it pauses and asks you to continue. Set 0 for no step limit; the time budget, the consecutive-failure stop and the repeated-action stop still apply.

continued.agent.maxRunMinutes.description: How long one agent run may work before it pauses, in minutes (default 4 hours). Time spent waiting for your approval is not counted. Set 0 for no time limit; the step limit, the consecutive-failure stop and the repeated-action stop still apply.

continued.agent.maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Stop the run after this many actions in a row failed, were blocked or were declined, instead of letting the model keep retrying.

continued.agent.modelTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap in milliseconds for a single model call in agent mode, including a long generation that is still producing tokens. A timeout or dropped connection is retried once before the run stops.

continued.agent.modelStallTimeoutMs.description: How long in milliseconds a model may send nothing (no tokens, no reasoning) before the call is treated as stalled. Catches a dead connection quickly without cutting off slow models that are still working.

continued.agent.commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for shell commands run by the agent.

continued.agent.maxContextChars.description: Character budget for the conversation history sent to the model. Lower this for small local models.

continued.agent.maxHistoryMessages.description: Maximum number of recent messages (including tool results) sent to the model.

continued.agent.maxToolOutputChars.description: Maximum characters of a read-file result passed back to the model.

continued.container.podmanPath.description: Podman executable used by "Run in a container". A bare name is looked up on PATH.

continued.container.outputDir.description: Where container runs write their results (output.txt, run_record.json), relative to the workspace unless absolute. Each run gets its own timestamped folder.

continued.container.extraPackages.description: Extra Debian packages to install in the container image, for tools the dependency analysis cannot see (for example when a command comes from the harness input).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && mocha --ui tdd out/src/test/agentActions.test.js out/src/test/agentGuardrails.test.js out/src/test/harnessEngine.test.js out/src/test/modelPicker.test.js out/src/test/portable.test.js out/src/test/cwl.test.js out/src/test/container.test.js out/src/test/modelBench.test.js out/src/test/repro.test.js out/src/test/conformance.test.js out/src/test/grounding.test.js
